Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week — Glacier Analytics is ready to move our offer into the Azure marketplace. Before we start the manifest upload we hit two items we need help with:

1) Service principal: your marketplace docs reference creating a delegated SP for the provisioning hook. Can you share an example JSON and call pattern? We have an internal security review that needs the exact permissions list.

2) Pricing tiers: Glacier wants to offer monthly and annual plans plus metered usage for inference minutes. Can Redwood support both SKU-based subscriptions and a metered offer? If so, what payloads do you recommend for the offer manifest?

Attached: high-level product brief (PDF).

Subject: Re: Request: Azure offer activation & SP guidance

Diego — copying the technical validation checklist below and a few clarifying notes.

--- Technical validation checklist (summary) ---
1) Publisher tenant ID & primary publisher email (MPN ID if available)
2) Service principal: we need the appId, objectId, and exact role assignments. Minimum recommended roles: Contributor on the resource group for test provisioning + Reader on the storage account if artifacts are staged there. Do not grant Owner.
3) Offer manifest: include SKU mapping for subscription vs metered dimension (see our sample manifest-sample.json).
4) Endpoint smoke test: a simple POST to /v1/infer with sample prompt (we verify 200, latency < 1s for short prompts).
5) Security evidence: SOC2 cert or ISO attestation, data residency statement, artifact retention policy.

Notes: For metered offers, Azure requires a usage dimension and a usage reporting endpoint. Redwood can emit usage reports to Glacier via the marketplace usage API (we provide a webhook URL to receive ingestion callbacks).

I’ve attached the manifest sample and a minimal SP template. If Glacier’s security team prefers, we can host the SP creation as a guided session; it takes ~20 minutes.

Marissa Cole
Director, Marketplace Integrations | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com

--
Attachments: manifest-sample.json (JSON stub), sp-instructions-short.pdf (PDF stub)
